_doc: Constants of a1_lipjet.py [X-LJET] (S41 2026-09-27): the lip jet of the two-wall march (plug_march lip_jet) against the planar simple-wave twin of the plug march's own oracle -- the corner fan generated AT the lip mid-march instead of living in the start data.

oracle.note: the planar simple-wave twin of plug_march's oracle (M1 1.5 meets the lip corner with ambient p(M2 2.2), lip at (0, 2), the plug = the exact streamline through (x_start, 1)), posed UPSTREAM of the lip: a uniform M1 start line at x_start between the plug (y 1) and a horizontal shroud (y 2) ending at the lip F, n_shroud stations; rungs = (K plug stations, N start rows, n_fan lip rays) halving; n_gl = the Gauss-Legendre order of the Prandtl-Meyer quadrature; stream_h = the RK4 step of the exact streamline; tail_frac = the edge tail averaged for its asymptotic angle and speed; p2_frac_min = the fraction of plug stations whose pressure must sit in the Richardson band (the oracle's own 90 percent rule); rej_qpa_factor = the corrupted ambient speed of rejector R-1 (the oracle's own 1 percent)
